question: Weak compression can cause high fuel consumption. What is the suggested solution?
solution:
The correct answer is __Replace the piston ring__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Weak compression__ can result in increased fuel consumption.
 
• This occurs due to improper sealing of the combustion chamber.
 
• Replacing the piston ring is an effective solution to restore proper compression.
 
• The piston ring ensures optimal pressure within the cylinder for fuel combustion.
 
• Proper compression improves engine efficiency and reduces fuel usage.
 
• It also prevents excessive wear and tear of engine components.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Air Filter Replacement:**

 
 
• A clogged air filter can reduce engine performance and increase fuel consumption.
 
• Replacing the air filter ensures proper air intake for combustion.
 
 
 
• **Fuel Leakage Repair:**
 
 
• Fuel leakage directly contributes to higher fuel consumption.
 
• Repairing leaks helps reduce fuel wastage and ensures safety.
 
 
 
• **Idle Speed Adjustment:**
 
 
• Incorrect idle speed can lead to inefficient fuel use.
 
• Adjusting the idle speed screw ensures proper engine operation.
